### Highlights

- **Metadata from AniList.** Each series is linked to its AniList entry and takes its title, summary, genres, writers, artists and cover from there instead of the scan site. MangaDex series link by MangaDex's own AniList link; others by title, and a doubtful match stays unlinked rather than linked wrong. A new weekly task keeps metadata current.
- **Link by hand.** A Metadata panel on the series page shows the link, searches AniList, and links, changes or unlinks a series. Unlinking brings back the source's metadata and cover.
- **Writers and artists.** `ComicInfo.xml` now has `Penciller` as well as `Writer`, filled from AniList and MangaDex.

### Upgrade notes

- Two database migrations run on start. No action needed.
- On first start every series is looked up on AniList. kaze stays under AniList's rate limit, so a large library takes a while (about half an hour for 300 series); downloads aren't held up.
- Linked series get AniList's title in the UI, notifications and new `ComicInfo.xml` files. Folders and existing files don't change.
- AniList's cover replaces `cover.*` in a linked series' folder.
